Loial speaks out in opposition to his mother's plan to open the Book of Translation.<br />A huge force of Trollocs and Myrddraal attacks. Rand manages to convince Lews Therin to release ''saidin'' before he draws too much again.<br />Verin departs, leaving a note for Rand. Loial tells Rand he will be leaving for Stedding Shangtai tomorrow; Elder Haman offers to stay in his place.<br />Bashere returns, with details of the arrangements for the meeting with the Daughter of the Nine Moons.
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 20
| Nynaeve takes Lan to World's End in Saldaea, from where he will ride to Malkier. Nynaeve begins to set the Malkieri in motion to follow Lan to the Blight.
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="daynum" rowspan="6" | 746
| rowspan="6" | Aine-23
| rowspan="6" | Apr-07
| class="chapter" | 21
| Rand visits the Stone of Tear. Alanna tells how Weiramon and Anaiyella have jeopardized the negotiations with the rebels. However, Bera brings news that the rebels have agreed to recognize Darlin as king of Tear. Rand prepares to send him, Weiramon and Anaiyella to Arad Doman.
| rowspan="6" |
[[Image:lastq.png]]
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 22
| In Illian, the First Twelve of the Sea Folk meet with Logain, who demands on Rand's behalf that their ships carry food and supplies to Arad Doman.<br />The Sea Folk are shaken when news arrives of the mass suicide of the Amayar in response to the destruction of the great ''sa'angreal'' on Tremalking.
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 23
| At a meeting of the rebel Hall called by Lelaine, Jahar Narishma presents an offer to allow the Aes Sedai to bond up to 47 Asha'man. He also tells of the woman channelling ''saidin'' who killed Eben Hopwil; Delana warns Halima and they make their escape from the camp before they can be arrested.
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 24
| Egwene questions Silviana on Shemerin's demotion to the Accepted. In the dining hall, all the novices stand to salute her.
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 25
| Tarna reports to Elaida, who is playing along with Meidani's attempt to seduce her. Elaida orders Egwene to attend her tonight.
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="backref" | 25
| At evening, Seta asks the Aes Sedai to teach her. Joline and Edesina eventually agree after she demonstrates her channelling.
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="daynum" rowspan="3" | 747
| rowspan="3" | Aine-24
| rowspan="3" | Apr-08
| class="chapter" | 25
| On a whim, Tuon allows Mat to kiss her.<br />Vanin arrives with Talmanes, who tells Mat that the pass through the Damona Mountains has been blocked by a landslide.
| rowspan="3" | <br />
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 26
| Talmanes leads them to the camp of the Band. Mat begins studying the Seanchan positions and making plans.
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 26
| Approaching Malden at night, Perrin makes contact with the wolves, reminding them the attack is set for two days hence.<br />Perrin and co. dump the forkroot into the aqueduct supplying water to Malden. Seonid leads a group into the aqueduct to sneak into the burned-out fortress in preparation for the attack.<br />Perrin returns to the camp near Brytan to find a ''raken'' has arrived. Tylee tells him 7000 Whitecloaks led by Galad are nearby. There are also two large parties of Aiel approaching from the southeast and southwest, due to arrive within three days.<br />Suddenly, the world "ripples" three times.<br />''Fat crescent moon''
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="daynum" rowspan="3" | 748
| rowspan="3" | Aine-25
| rowspan="3" | Apr-09
| class="chapter" | 26
| After fending off Rolan's attempts to start a kissing game with her, Faile tells Galina she has the oath rod. Galina tells her to meet her in the burned-out southern part of Malden tomorrow.
| rowspan="3" | <br />
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 27
| Rand's party arrive at Lady Deidru's manor, for his meeting with the Daughter of the Nine Moons. They are met by ''sul'dam'' and ''damane'', with "Tuon"—who turns out to be a disguised Semirhage. The Forsaken destroys Rand's left hand with a fireball, but is captured along with her entourage. Rand send the captured ''sul'dam'' and ''damane'' back to Ebou Dar.
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 27
| At evening, Mat launches attacks on the Seanchan camps. He and the Band lure the lancers in the Molvaine Gap into an ambush.<br />''Fat crescent moon''
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="daynum" rowspan="7" | 749
| rowspan="7" | Aine-26
| rowspan="7" | Apr-10
| class="chapter" | 28
| Just before dawn, Faile, Maighdin and Alliandre prepare to leave, tying up Dairaine to prevent her going to Sevanna.<br />They meet Galina in a burned-out building, and Faile gives her the oath rod. Galina collapses the building, trapping them. Maighdin tries to attract attention by channelling, and Galina makes her escape from Malden as Perrin's forces arrive.
| rowspan="7" | <br />
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 29
| Under cover of fog, Perrin's forces approach Malden. He learns from Balwer that Masema is here with his army. He sends Basel Gill and his people away to the north. Tylee's lieutenant Arabah arrives with Neald and tells Perrin the approaching Aiel bands are moving faster than expected, and will arrive later today.
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 29
| Aravine and others loyal to Faile arrive to rescue her party. Rolan is with them.
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 29
| Grady arrives at Perrin's side with Tam al'Thor, who Perrin nominates as his First Captain.<br />As a column of Shaido come towards them, Perrin's forces advance out of the fog. The few Shaido Wise Ones who escaped the forkroot begin to channel against them. The Shaido ''algai'd'siswai'' are routed.
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 30
| As the battle rages outside Malden, Rolan and the others rescue Faile's party. Maighdin collapses after drinking some water [due to the forkroot].
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 30
| Aram, corrupted by Masema, is killed by two Shaido before he can kill Perrin.<br />Perrin finally finds Faile; he kills Rolan. The other two ''Mera'din'' are killed by Faile and Lacile. They begin moving the ''gai'shain'' prisoners north. Gaul leaves to find Chiad; Elyas goes with him.<br />Tylee arrives with Sevanna as her prisoner and the news that the Shaido are surrendering, but that Masema has survived with a hundred of his bodyguard.
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 30
| Galina is found and reclaimed by Therava. The remnant of the Shaido, with the now broken Galina, begin their retreat to the Three-Fold Land.

| In the small hours of the morning, Duhara arrives in Caemlyn, having been sent by Elaida to be Elayne's advisor. Elayne sends her away.<br />Norry and Hark bring news of Mellar's meeting with Shiaine and the Black Ajah sisters. Elayne takes Vandene, Careane, Sareitha, and their Warders, and leaves immediately for Shiaine's house on Full Moon Street.<br />Entering the house, they are taken by surprise by the Black Ajah there in force. Careane is unmasked as a Darkfriend and killed by Vandene, before Vandene and Sareitha are both killed in turn.
| rowspan="2" | <br />
|- bgcolor="#b0b0b0" valign="top" style="color: black;"
| class="chapter" | 32-33
| Birgitte returns to the palace and prepares a rescue party. She convinces the Windfinders to make a gateway for them to Travel outside the city. A messenger arrives with news of an attack on the Far Madding gate.<br />On the ridge east of the city, Birgitte's party see Arymilla's forces assaulting Caemlyn. The Black Ajah sisters attack with lightning and balefire, but the linked Windfinders kill one of them (Asne Zeramene) and capture the others. Elayne is rescued, and decides to attack Arymilla's forces from the rear.<br />In a battle in Low Caemlyn outside the Far Madding gate, the rebels are defeated. Arymilla, Naean and Elenia are captured. Sylvase, now High Seat of House Caeren, declares for Elayne, as do Lir and Karid.
